body.ruleText:
rule dac_gh_0002 {
  meta:
    author = "DaC"
    description = "GitHub: SSH key added to account - Detects SSH key additions which can indicate persistence on a compromised GitHub account."
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0002"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.ssh_key.add" nocase
    $action = $e.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $action over 1h

  outcome:
    $count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $actors = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e
}
